```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)

d <- readRDS(params$data_path)

herb <- d$herbarium

empty_msg <- function(txt) {
  htmltools::p(txt, style = "color: #6c757d; font-style: italic;")
}

# The link itself is the hyperlink text
as_link <- function(x) {
  ifelse(!is.na(x) & nzchar(x),
         paste0('<a href="', x, '" target="_blank">', x, '</a>'), "")
}
```

## Overview

Specimens of the **`r herb`** herbarium (records from `r d$herbarium_source`)
lacking the family, the genus or the specific epithet
(**`r d$taxon_label`**) were compared with the records of
**`r paste(d$sources, collapse = " and ")`**, standardized with
[barRoso](https://github.com/DBOSlab/barRoso), to find duplicates (same
collector and collector number, or same species, collector and date when the
number is missing) held by **other herbaria**. REFLORA herbaria already in JABOT are
used only from JABOT. A duplicate is a candidate
identification when it fills at least one missing rank and does not disagree
with the ranks already present in the specimen.

```{r kpi-boxes}
htmltools::tags$div(
  class = "kpi-row",
  htmltools::tags$div(
    class = "kpi-box kpi-blue",
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-value", scales::comma(d$n_indets)),
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-label",
                        paste0("Indeterminate specimens in ", herb))
  ),
  htmltools::tags$div(
    class = "kpi-box kpi-gray",
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-value", scales::comma(d$n_matchable)),
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-label",
                        "With collector and number (can be matched)")
  ),
  htmltools::tags$div(
    class = "kpi-box kpi-amber",
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-value", scales::comma(d$n_with_dups)),
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-label",
                        "With duplicates in other herbaria")
  ),
  htmltools::tags$div(
    class = "kpi-box kpi-green",
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-value", scales::comma(d$n_resolvable)),
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-label",
                        "With a candidate identification")
  ),
  htmltools::tags$div(
    class = "kpi-box kpi-coral",
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-value", scales::comma(d$n_conflict)),
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-label",
                        "Duplicates identified differently")
  )
)
```

## Outcome for the Indeterminate Specimens

Each indeterminate specimen falls into one outcome, according to the best
identification found among its duplicates.

```{r plot-outcome, fig.height=4.5}
ggplotly(d$plots$outcome, tooltip = "text")
```

---

## Herbaria Holding Identified Duplicates

Herbaria that hold a duplicate with a candidate identification, ranked by the
number of `r herb` specimens they could help to identify.

```{r plot-source, fig.height=6}
if (is.null(d$plots$source)) {
  empty_msg("No candidate identification was found in other herbaria.")
} else {
  ggplotly(d$plots$source, tooltip = "text")
}
```

## Indeterminate Specimens by Family

```{r plot-family, fig.height=6.5}
if (is.null(d$plots$family)) {

} else {
```

## Specimens with a Candidate Identification

Indeterminate specimens of `r herb` for which a duplicate in another herbarium
supplies the missing rank(s). Check the identification, preferably against the
specimen images, before adopting it.

```{r table-candidates}
cand <- d$indets[d$indets$n_useful > 0, , drop = FALSE]

if (nrow(cand) == 0) {
  empty_msg("No specimen has a duplicate with a candidate identification.")
} else {
  cand$specimenLink <- as_link(cand$specimenLink)
  cand$suggestedSpecimenLink <- as_link(cand$suggestedSpecimenLink)
  labs <- c(catalogNumber = "Catalog number", recordedBy = "Collector",
            recordNumber = "Coll. number",
            identifiedBy = paste0("Identified by (", herb, ")"),
            dateIdentified = paste0("Date identified (", herb, ")"),
            year = "Year", stateProvince = "State",
            currentIdentification = "Current identification",
            suggestedIdentification = "Suggested identification",
            suggestedFamily = "Suggested family",
            suggestedFrom = "Source duplicate",
            suggestedSource = "Data source (duplicate)",
            suggestedIdentifiedBy = "Identified by (source duplicate)",
            suggestedDateIdentified = "Date identified (source duplicate)",
            outcome = "Outcome", n_useful = "Candidate duplicates",
            specimenLink = paste0("Specimen link (", herb, ")"),
            suggestedSpecimenLink = "Specimen link (source duplicate)")
  cols <- names(labs)[names(labs) %in% names(cand)]

  DT::datatable(
    cand[, cols, drop = FALSE],
    colnames = unname(labs[cols]),
    rownames = FALSE,
    escape = FALSE,
    filter = list(position = "top", clear = TRUE, plain = FALSE),
    extensions = "Buttons",
    caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
      style = "caption-side: top; text-align: left; font-weight: bold;",
      paste0("Table 1. ", scales::comma(nrow(cand)),
             " indeterminate specimens of ", herb,
             " with a candidate identification.")),
    options = list(
      pageLength = 20, dom = "Bfrtip",
      buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel"), scrollX = TRUE,
      search = list(regex = TRUE, caseInsensitive = TRUE),
      lengthMenu = list(c(10, 20, 50, 100, -1),
                        c("10", "20", "50", "100", "All")))
  )
}
```

## Conflicts Between Duplicates

Duplicates identified with a name that disagrees with the family, genus or
epithet already present in the `r herb` specimen (a possible misidentification
in one of the herbaria). No identification is suggested from them. Both
identifications are shown with who identified each specimen and when, with the
links to both specimens, to help deciding which one to trust.

```{r table-conflicts}
sug_all <- d$suggestions
conf <- sug_all[sug_all$fills_missing_rank & !sug_all$compatible, ,
                drop = FALSE]

if (nrow(conf) == 0) {
  empty_msg("No conflicting identification was found.")
} else {
  conf$specimenLink <- as_link(conf$specimenLink)
  conf$dup_specimenLink <- as_link(conf$dup_specimenLink)
  labs <- c(catalogNumber = "Catalog number", recordedBy = "Collector",
            recordNumber = "Coll. number",
            currentIdentification = paste0("Identification (", herb, ")"),
            identifiedBy = paste0("Identified by (", herb, ")"),
            dateIdentified = paste0("Date identified (", herb, ")"),
            dup_herbarium = "Duplicate herbarium",
            dup_source = "Data source (duplicate)",
            dup_catalogNumber = "Duplicate catalog number",
            dup_identification = "Identification (duplicate)",
            dup_identifiedBy = "Identified by (duplicate)",
            dup_dateIdentified = "Date identified (duplicate)",
            specimenLink = paste0("Specimen link (", herb, ")"),
            dup_specimenLink = "Specimen link (duplicate)")
  cols <- names(labs)[names(labs) %in% names(conf)]

  DT::datatable(
    conf[, cols, drop = FALSE],
    colnames = unname(labs[cols]),
    rownames = FALSE,
    escape = FALSE,
    filter = list(position = "top", clear = TRUE, plain = FALSE),
    extensions = "Buttons",
    caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
      style = "caption-side: top; text-align: left; font-weight: bold;",
      paste0("Table 2. ", nrow(conf), " duplicates identified differently ",
             "from the ", herb, " specimen.")),
    options = list(
      pageLength = 10, dom = "Bfrtip",
      buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel"), scrollX = TRUE,
      search = list(regex = TRUE, caseInsensitive = TRUE))
  )
}
```

## All Duplicates Found

Every duplicate held by another herbaria, one row per specimen and duplicate,
with the identification it carries (and who identified it and when, for the
specimen of `r herb` and for the duplicate, to help deciding which one to
trust when the identifications conflict) and the links to both specimens, so that
the images of the indeterminate specimen and of its duplicate can be opened
side by side. `fills_missing_rank` tells whether it
supplies a rank missing in the `r herb` specimen and `compatible` whether it
agrees with the ranks already present.

```{r table-suggestions}
sug <- d$suggestions

if (nrow(sug) == 0) {
  empty_msg("No duplicate was found in other herbaria.")
} else {
  sug$specimenLink <- as_link(sug$specimenLink)
  sug$dup_specimenLink <- as_link(sug$dup_specimenLink)
  cols <- c("catalogNumber", "currentIdentification", "recordedBy",
            "recordNumber", "identifiedBy", "dateIdentified",
            "dup_herbarium", "dup_source", "dup_catalogNumber",
            "dup_identification", "dup_identifiedBy", "dup_dateIdentified",
            "fills_missing_rank", "compatible", "specimenLink",
            "dup_specimenLink")
  cols <- cols[cols %in% names(sug)]
  labs <- c(catalogNumber = "Catalog number",
            currentIdentification = "Current identification",
            recordedBy = "Collector", recordNumber = "Coll. number",
            identifiedBy = paste0("Identified by (", herb, ")"),
            dateIdentified = paste0("Date identified (", herb, ")"),
            dup_herbarium = "Duplicate herbarium",
            dup_source = "Data source (duplicate)",
            dup_catalogNumber = "Duplicate catalog number",
            dup_identification = "Duplicate identification",
            dup_identifiedBy = "Identified by (duplicate)",
            dup_dateIdentified = "Date identified (duplicate)",
            fills_missing_rank = "Fills missing rank",
            compatible = "Compatible",
            specimenLink = paste0("Specimen link (", herb, ")"),
            dup_specimenLink = "Specimen link (duplicate)")

  DT::datatable(
    sug[, cols, drop = FALSE],
    colnames = unname(labs[cols]),
    rownames = FALSE,
    escape = FALSE,
    filter = list(position = "top", clear = TRUE, plain = FALSE),
    extensions = "Buttons",
    caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
      style = "caption-side: top; text-align: left; font-weight: bold;",
      paste0("Table 3. ", scales::comma(nrow(sug)),
             " duplicates found in other herbaria.")),
    options = list(
      pageLength = 20, dom = "Bfrtip",
      buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel"), scrollX = TRUE,
      search = list(regex = TRUE, caseInsensitive = TRUE),
      lengthMenu = list(c(10, 20, 50, 100, -1),
                        c("10", "20", "50", "100", "All")))
  ) %>%
    DT::formatStyle(
      "fills_missing_rank",
      backgroundColor = DT::styleEqual(c(TRUE, FALSE),
                                       c("#dcfce7", "#f1f3f5")))
}
```

## Complete List of Indeterminate Specimens

```{r table-all}
all_ind <- d$indets
all_ind$specimenLink <- as_link(all_ind$specimenLink)
cols <- c("catalogNumber", "recordedBy", "recordNumber", "identifiedBy",
          "dateIdentified", "year", "stateProvince", "municipality",
          "currentIdentification",
          "outcome", "n_duplicates", "specimenLink")
cols <- cols[cols %in% names(all_ind)]
labs <- c(catalogNumber = "Catalog number", recordedBy = "Collector",
          recordNumber = "Coll. number",
          identifiedBy = paste0("Identified by (", herb, ")"),
          dateIdentified = paste0("Date identified (", herb, ")"),
          year = "Year", stateProvince = "State", municipality = "Municipality",
          currentIdentification = "Current identification",
          outcome = "Outcome", n_duplicates = "Duplicates",
          specimenLink = paste0("Specimen link (", herb, ")"))

DT::datatable(
  all_ind[, cols, drop = FALSE],
  colnames = unname(labs[cols]),
  rownames = FALSE,
  escape = FALSE,
  filter = list(position = "top", clear = TRUE, plain = FALSE),
  extensions = "Buttons",
  caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
    style = "caption-side: top; text-align: left; font-weight: bold;",
    paste0("Table 4. All ", scales::comma(nrow(all_ind)),
           " indeterminate specimens of ", herb, ".")),
  options = list(
    pageLength = 20, dom = "Bfrtip",
    buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel"), scrollX = TRUE,
    search = list(regex = TRUE, caseInsensitive = TRUE),
    lengthMenu = list(c(10, 20, 50, 100, -1),
                      c("10", "20", "50", "100", "All")))
)
```
